title: Link SLO burn alerts to status page update runbook + component taxonomy
author: Aisha Bello
description: Context: As part of the status page transparency upgrades, on-call needs a fast, consistent path from a page to (a) the correct status-page component taxonomy and (b) the exact runbook steps for posting/updating component statuses. Today, most of our burn-rate alerts include a generic runbook link (or no runbook at all), and nothing points to the canonical taxonomy/mapping guidance. This PR updates alert annotations across component-level SLO burn alerts in this repo to include: (1) a status page update runbook link, and (2) a status page component taxonomy link. It also standardizes annotation keys so incident-bot and human responders can reliably surface the right links in Slack. Scope: alert rule annotations + lint/test updates only; no threshold or routing changes. Notes: we intentionally keep the links to high-level canonical docs rather than incident-specific pages, and we avoid language that implies an SLA/guarantee. Rollout: safe to merge; annotations-only; validated in staging alertmanager and via jsonnet render output. Follow-ups: once merged, we can have incident-bot surface these fields automatically in the intake + reminders (tracked elsewhere).
